title: I4C Issues Warning Against 'Boss Scam' WhatsApp CEO Impersonation Trojan Fraud
summary: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) issued advisory against 'Boss Scam' WhatsApp Web takeover Trojan malware.

blocks.content: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) issued advisory against 'Boss Scam' WhatsApp Web takeover Trojan malware.

items: **Fraud Mechanism:** WhatsApp CEO impersonation fraud installing Trojan malware on Windows devices via malicious files.
**Nodal Platform:** National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (NCRP) operating under MHA/I4C (National Helpline **1930**).
